author: Athul Prem
scope: Four new two-hole runs at 1 GHz, nominal fixed-property Ge, left incidence, layered P2, h80 in-plane target and 48-segment holes. At a fixed port width grid, changing z layers preserves the exact footprint and changes both volume and port thickness resolution. Changing port width also remeshes the footprint. The saved tetrahedral h50 result is a finite-discretization cross-check. All reported criteria apply to the tested pairs at this frequency.
complex_encoding: [real, imaginary] pairs; outgoing rows and incoming columns

comparison.author: Athul Prem
comparison.scope: Saved runs are compared at the same reference planes after matching unit-power channels. The comparison covers one frequency and incidence side. Mesh-pair checks require distinct discretizations and passing input power-balance checks. A pass does not establish continuum accuracy or a frequency-band result.

uniform_common_reference.scope: Offline comparison at the original end planes for two saved uniform P2 layered guides at 1 GHz and left incidence. Both are compared against zero reflection and propagation with the same finite 8-by-4 SAFE section. This checks the tested uniform responses, with no continuum error bound or patterned-device acceptance.

reference_phase_qualification.scope: Successive SAFE section differences at this propagation distance. No continuum error bound.
